title: hieracium maledictum
intro: Hieracium maledictum, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Western Asia, characterized by its blue or purple flowers. The health benefits of Hieracium maledictum include its potential to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. Bioactive constituents of Hieracium maledictum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
